header.case_description: Palo Verde nuclear trip in the public ParaEMT WECC240 case. 243 grid buses, 111 synchronous machines and 91 inverter plants.
header.case_comments: ParaEMT_public d79d735a: pfd_240_1_1.json and 240bus.xls. GridKit uses three-phase winding machines, the WECC240 LCL bridge design, and transformer excitation of 0.00001 pu with zero core loss. Inductive loads are series RL. The nuclear breaker is an ideal switch. From 1 s, each phase opens at its next current zero. Its isolated 20 kV terminal has 1 uF per phase.
